scale.temperature_display: text-[5rem] sm:text-[6rem] leading-none tracking-tighter font-light text-slate-900

surfaces.crystal_glass: bg-white/40 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/40 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] rounded-3xl
surfaces.heavy_glass: bg-white/60 backdrop-blur-3xl border border-white/50 shadow-sm rounded-2xl
surfaces.search_bar: bg-white/40 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/50 shadow-inner rounded-full px-6 py-3 focus-within:bg-white/60 focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-white/80 transition-all

layout.spacing_system: Generous padding inside panels (p-6 or p-8). Avoid cramped content.
layout.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 max-w-5xl mx-auto
layout.forecast_strip: col-span-1 md:col-span-12 flex gap-4 overflow-x-auto pb-4 snap-x

bg_sunny.usage: Background image for clear/sunny weather condition. Span entire viewport, object-cover.

bg_rainy.usage: Background image for rain/drizzle/storm weather condition.

bg_night.usage: Background image for clear night weather condition.

bg_cloudy.usage: Background image for cloudy/overcast weather condition.

motion.page_load: Fade in and slight upward translation (staggered) for bento grid cards using framer-motion.
motion.hover: Cards should have a subtle hover effect (slight lift and brightness increase).
motion.weather_icons: Subtle looping float or pulse animations for main weather condition icons.

components_strategy.icons: lucide-react, using absolute consistent sizes and light stroke-width.
components_strategy.search: Custom glassmorphism input. Do not use default opaque Shadcn inputs.
components_strategy.temperature_toggle: Pill-shaped toggle, active state is a solid white background block shifting over the C or F.
components_strategy.general: Avoid standard generic Shadcn 'Card' wrappers. Use raw divs with 'crystal_glass' classes defined above for precise frosted effect.

accessibility.contrast: Text over glass must be highly contrasted. Use slate-900 or slate-800.
accessibility.testing_ids: Mandatory data-testid attributes on: city-search-input, search-submit-button, geolocate-button, temp-unit-toggle, current-weather-card.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the background logic to switch between the 4 provided media URLs based on current OpenWeatherMap conditions.
Apply 'background-size: cover', 'background-position: center', and 'background-attachment: fixed' to the main container.
Wrap all content inside a bento grid structure to give a dashboard-like feeling, but space it out beautifully.
For the 5-day forecast, use a horizontal scroll layout on mobile and a wrap or flex row on desktop.
Use Outfit for the main temperature number, making it very large but thin (font-light).
Ensure the entire app is fully responsive, defaulting to grid-cols-1 on mobile.
